question: A retry was built for a model that no longer fails that way. What do you do?

options.text: A reminder in the README to read the rules.
options.why: Tempting. A reminder depends on someone reading it.

options.text: A mechanical check that finds names the code no longer defines, run on every change.
options.why: Right. It runs without anyone remembering.

options.text: A longer rules file, so nothing is missed.
options.why: Tempting and wrong. A longer file has more names to go stale.

question: Which check fights entropy in a rules file?

options.text: More prose in the docs, so every rule is written down.
options.why: Tempting. Long docs go stale faster than checks catch them.

options.text: A check that runs fast and names the missing function.
options.why: Right. Fast checks and clear errors are what a harness can use.
